messages:
maria: heads up — we're seeing a small spike in errors from customers using the new experimental routing header. question: should the SDKs auto-strip unknown route flags or let them pass through?
kevin: what's the exact error surface? 400s from server or client-side validation failures?
sophia: server returns 422 for unknown route attributes right now. console-ingest flagged some malformed telemetry too.
alex: iirc the header format is `X-RdRoute: v2;pref=lowcost;flag=beta` — older SDKs encode it slightly differently (no `v2` prefix).
maria: yeah that's part of it. recent go/py/ts releases started emitting the `v2` prefix behind a feature flag. some proxies choke if they see unexpected token.
jules: deploy-bot: rollout-note — canary 10% -> 25% for routing-experiment in us-west at 11:12am :sparkles:
kevin: two options: 1) SDKs strip unknown tokens before send, 2) infra tolerates unknown tokens (lenient parse).
sophia: leaning toward lenient parse server-side — keeps SDKs stable. but console telemetry expects `v2` to parse route taxonomy, so we might lose telemetry if we strip client-side.
alex: agree. if server-side accepts unknown tokens we don't break existing clients. but we need to emit a metric when parse falls back so console can surface matches.
maria: can we add a `route_parse_fallback` metric in the ingest path? short-term, yes. long-term, want SDKs to opt-into `v2` explicitly via feature flag.
jules: +1 for fallback metric. also we should update the devex guide with snippet for opt-in:

```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(..., feature_flags={"route_v2": True})
```

alex: for TS/Go similar flags exist. but there's already a report of TS 1.8.2 sending `v2` without flag — looks like a release bug.
kevin: ok action items: 1) rollback that TS patch to 1.8.1 on NPM (patch release), 2) infra: make ingest lenient + emit `route_parse_fallback`, 3) SDK: add sanitization opt-out (so users can strip if they want). Who wants to own each?
maria: i'll take SDK sanitization opt-out for py + coord with dev docs.
alex: i'll open the TS rollback PR and ping release infra.
sophia: i'll file the infra ticket for lenient parsing + metric and attach the log sample.
jules: i'll update canary plan and hold 10% till infra change lands. deploy-bot: notify when infra PR merged.
deploy-bot: noted — will post status when CI green and merge occurs.
kevin: also add e2e: a tiny test that sends a malformed token and asserts server responds 200 (with fallback) and emits metric. lab test can live in infra/e2e-routing.
naria: (oops typo) — meant to say thanks :thumbsup: will start docs update now.
maria: thanks folks. i'll post progress updates here. if anyone sees customer tickets escalate tag me and @kevin.
